baseline_ref: EXP-001 (TARGET_MODE=cartridge_plus_doc, per_document, USE_IDF=0, top_t=64, per_layer, freeze, ridge 1e-4 spectral, delta 1e-2)
verdict: WIRING NO-OP (a bug). target_mode is parsed, reaches the config, is written into the run name and the wandb tags, and is then NEVER READ by the per_document execution path. The per-document write is hard-wired to cartridge_plus_doc semantics. EXP-008 therefore did NOT test the target lever: it re-ran the EXP-001 configuration three times. HYP-T1's 'NULL' must be retracted; the target lever is UN-TESTED, not dead. The EXP-008 numbers are not stale-cache or same-checkpoint artifacts -- three genuinely separate GPU runs each executed 16 documents and each independently produced the identical cache.

observations: VERDICT: wiring no-op. TARGET_MODE is correctly parsed (continual_am_sparse.py:78) and correctly reaches the config (continual_am_sparse.py:153) -- the EXP-008 logs even echo 'target_mode: self' and 'target_mode: teacher_attention' from train_continual_am_sparse.sh:50 -- but the per_document execution path never reads it. run_per_document_am_phase2 (cartridges/am/continual.py:41-265) contains zero occurrences of the string 'target_mode' (verified by inspect.getsource), and apply_document_am_write_to_cache (cartridges/am/finetune.py:337-595) takes config but never branches on config.target_mode: it unconditionally builds the teacher KV at finetune.py:464 (concat_teacher_kv) and unconditionally computes targets = compute_teacher_targets(queries, k_teacher, v_teacher, ...) at finetune.py:477-484. The per-document write is therefore hard-wired to cartridge_plus_doc semantics, and it cannot express teacher_attention at all -- the function signature has no target_accumulator parameter, and continual.py:172 discards the accumulator slot with '_' while calling _collect_reference_queries with collect_teacher_targets left at its default False. The only reads of config.target_mode in the whole repo are finetune.py:630 and finetune.py:672-676 (both inside run_decoupled_tfidf_am_update, i.e. execution_mode=legacy_decoupled) and train.py:591 (the deprecated train_loop). PROOF: the CPU unit check shows the three targets are genuinely different tensors when built explicitly (max abs differences 1.22 / 3.44 / 3.56 on the synthetic fixture), yet running apply_document_am_write_to_cache once per mode on a fresh identical cache gives BITWISE-IDENTICAL updated values (max|dV| = 0.000e+00, and identical mean_mse 0.03795905038714409 to all 17 digits) for all three modes. The positive control confirms the target machinery itself works where it is wired: apply_am_update_to_cache with target_mode='self' vs 'teacher_attention' gives max|dV| = 16.62 and mean_mse 1.35e-08 vs 0.845. ALTERNATIVE EXPLANATIONS RULED OUT: (a) stale cache / same-checkpoint-evaluated-3x is refuted -- the three runs have distinct run dirs and distinct wall clocks (EXP-001 181.4s solve, EXP-008 self 169.3s, EXP-008 teacher 165.2s), each independently processed 16 documents, and each independently wrote a cache_last.pt; those three caches are bitwise identical across all 180 tensors, which is the expected outcome of a deterministic solve on an identical objective, not of a file being re-read; (b) the dual-cartridges foot-gun (RUNBOOK 6.10) is refuted -- import resolves to the _explore repo AND all eight cartridges/am/*.py files are byte-identical between _explore and the sibling repo, so both packages ignore target_mode identically; (c) the write itself is not dead -- EXP-001's cache differs from the Phase-1 cache by max|dV| = 798.9 with max|dK| = 0 exactly as freeze_keys predicts. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE BOARD: EXP-008 is three replicas of EXP-001, not a sweep; HYP-T1's 'NULL' verdict rests on no evidence and the target lever is untested. Two smaller latent hazards found in the same area: (i) finetune.py:672-676 silently downgrades target_mode='cartridge_plus_doc' to 'self' in the legacy_decoupled path (because apply_am_update_to_cache raises ValueError on that value at finetune.py:186), so the legacy path also mislabels one of its three modes; (ii) EXP-008 ran with WANDB_DISABLED=1 (launch_exp008.sh:67) so there is no wandb run for either arm, and no result.json was ever written for EXP-008. MINIMAL FIX SKETCH (described only, NOT applied, per the task's hard rule) -- Part 1, make the lever real, opt-in so every existing config stays bit-identical: in cartridges/am/finetune.py::apply_document_am_write_to_cache, wrap the target construction at L477-484 in a branch on config.target_mode. Keep the current code verbatim under 'cartridge_plus_doc' (the default -> bit-identical reproduction of EXP-001..EXP-009). For 'self', set targets = None and skip the teacher concat, letting the solve fall into the existing targets-is-None self-match branch (value_solve.py:69-70 for sparse_am_value_update, value_solve.py:210-211 for guarded_sparse_am_value_update); note target_log_mass (finetune.py:485) is consumed only by the beta/NNLS fit, so under key_mode=freeze with enable_beta unset (_should_fit_beta, finetune.py:256-261) it can be computed lazily behind the fit_beta flag. Part 2, for 'teacher_attention' three call-sites need plumbing that does not exist today: (a) cartridges/am/continual.py:172-182 must pass collect_teacher_targets=(config.target_mode=='teacher_attention') -- the parameter already exists at finetune.py:274 -- and keep the AMTargetAccumulator currently thrown away as '_'; (b) apply_document_am_write_to_cache needs a new optional target_accumulator kwarg, defaulting to None so existing callers are unaffected; (c) inside the head loop it must call target_acc.get_layer_head_targets(layer_idx, head_idx, n_q_heads=n_q_heads_actual, n_kv_heads=n_kv_heads) and truncate to min(n_targets, n_queries) exactly as apply_am_update_to_cache already does at finetune.py:170-184. Two correctness traps for that part: the query subsample at finetune.py:425-428 uses torch.randperm on queries only, so the SAME index tensor must be applied to targets (the legacy path does this at finetune.py:188-192 and the per-doc path currently has no equivalent); and teacher-attention capture costs a second no-cache forward per batch (finetune.py:315-330), roughly doubling per-document collect time. Part 3, a 3-line fail-loud guard that changes no numerics and prevents this class of silent no-op from recurring: at the top of run_per_document_am_phase2 (cartridges/am/continual.py, right after the docstring at L56) raise ValueError if config.target_mode is a value this path does not implement -- with Part 1 in place that guard only needs to cover the still-unimplemented modes.
